value.rationale: The all-k>=4 multiplicity-free decomposition is a natural, precise representation-theoretic refinement of the known Johnson-complex wedge theorem. The k-1 different irreducibles and lack of symmetric/alternating invariant cycles are not derivable from a scalar sphere count. The J(8,4) case is the first self-complementary graph and a nontrivial 181-dimensional example; an unbounded structural classification is mathematically motivated. The claim is not an arbitrary numerical slice or routine rank recomputation.
